_about: The Children's Book: A Collection of the Best and Most Famous Stories and Poems in the English Language, chosen by Horace E. Scudder (Boston: Houghton, Mifflin, 1881), the one-volume household anthology that the later multi-volume children's sets grew from. Internet Archive scan, raw OCR. Added 2026-10-23 at Adam's ask for old children's sets.
